feature: MQTT managed Keep Alive one-shot strong-CAS renewal

candidate.design: Replace the positive-deadline weak-CAS retry loop with one strong compare/exchange. The Connection's single receive owner serializes renewals; the only intended concurrent transition is the lifecycle driver's exact expiry claim.

benchmark.completion: Every arm completed exactly 100000 deliveries with checksum 25725000.

correctness.focused_debug: 131/131 broker Keep Alive and managed-deadline tests passed
preserved_invariants: a deadline claimed as expired cannot be resurrected
complete packet and large-body progress use the same 1.5x timeout calculation
the lifecycle driver still claims the exact observed deadline

rejection_reason: On AArch64 LSE the weak and strong CAS primitives do not provide the expected hot-path reduction. The candidate regressed broker instructions 0.135%, elapsed time 1.60%, p50 1.89%, and p99 7.47%; cycles were mixed. The source was removed before wider QoS/interop gates.

final_state.follow_up: Keep the exact weak-CAS expiry race. Future common-path work should target event-loop scheduling or packet decode work rather than changing the atomic primitive.
